programmes.funder: Agencia Nacional de Investigación e Innovación (ANII), Uruguay
programmes.amount_note: ANII contributes up to UYU 3,000,000 per venture, channelled through accredited Instituciones Patrocinadoras (incubators, accelerators and business angel clubs) which mentor the venture.
programmes.deadline_note: Postulación permanente - the call is permanently open with no closing date, evaluated on a rolling basis.

procedure_steps.detail: Choose an ANII-accredited Institución Patrocinadora (incubator, accelerator or angel club).
Develop the project with that institution.
Submit jointly through the ANII portal (permanent window).
Evaluation, then contract and milestone-based disbursement with mentoring.

documents_required.doc: Uruguayan RUT or commitment to incorporate

eligibility.other_note: Uruguayan ventures with an innovative, scalable and high-growth business model; the venture must be sponsored by an accredited institution.

programmes.source_snippet: APOYO A EMPRENDIMIENTOS INNOVADORES - Postulación permanente

programmes.funder: Agencia Nacional de Investigación e Innovación (ANII), Uruguay
programmes.amount_note: Supports Uruguayan innovative ventures to internationalise. The specific ceiling is set in each edition's bases.
programmes.deadline_note: The most recent edition ran from 26 February 2026 to 26 March 2026 and is listed by ANII under 'Llamados cerrados'.
programmes.reopen_note: ANII has run Uruguay al Mundo as an annual call opening in late February and closing in late March. Watch https://anii.org.uy/apoyos/emprendimientos/ for the next edition, and note that the permanently open 'Apoyo a Emprendimientos Innovadores' call remains available in the meantime.

procedure_steps.detail: Wait for the annual call to open (historically late February).
Submit through the ANII portal before the March closing date.

eligibility.other_note: Uruguayan innovative ventures with a validated product seeking to enter foreign markets.

programmes.name_en: Sprint UY immersion programme for international startups
programmes.funder: Uruguay XXI with the Agencia Nacional de Investigación e Innovación (ANII)
programmes.amount_note: An intensive in-country immersion programme (not a cash grant) designed to promote the installation and expansion of innovative ventures in Uruguay. Travel and stay support is provided to selected startups.
programmes.deadline_note: The third edition ran 5-9 October 2026 in Uruguay, with applications closing on 21 July 2026.
programmes.reopen_note: Sprint UY has run annually since its first edition; the 2026 call closed on 21 July for an October programme. Expect a similar mid-year window for the next edition, announced by Uruguay XXI and ANII.

procedure_steps.detail: Watch Uruguay XXI and ANII channels for the annual call.
Apply online before the closing date.
Attend the week-long immersion programme in Uruguay.

eligibility.other_note: Open to international startups considering establishing or expanding operations in Uruguay.

programmes.source_snippet: La convocatoria estará abierta hasta el 21 de julio de 2026.
